knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以 RFC 9113 的「HTTP/2」作具名案例，研究以下介面或演算法：HTTP/2流控計入整個DATA payload含padding相關欄位，但不含9 B frame header。 本課從明示的離線資料建立證據，不要求接觸營運網路。
knowledge.textEn: Use RFC 9113 as the named primary case for HTTP/2: DATA padding and flow-control accounting. HTTP/2 flow control counts the full DATA payload including padding-related fields, excluding the9 B frame header. Build evidence from explicit offline fixtures without accessing operational networks.

stages.descriptionEn:
Separate frame header, flow-controlled payload and application data into three columns.
Start window65535 B; four DATA payloads each16000 B include100 B nonapplication padding cost each; then receive WINDOW_UPDATE16384.
